title: RAINGLASS
art_style: Rain-drenched neon noir, high-contrast shadows, holographic overlays
short_summary: In the rain-soaked towers of Pacifica Arcology, Dr. James Park is found dead, his AI breakthrough at risk of corporate weaponization. Security chief Marcus Webb and AI specialist Dr. Sarah Chen must unravel a labyrinth of betrayal, synthetic clues, and digital misdirection. As clues point to Park’s protégés, and the AI-CORE itself glitches with guilt, trust collapses and a killer moves through the mist. The cost of truth may be everything.
world_context: Near-Future (2040s), Neo-San Francisco Arcology: a vertical city lost in glass, steel, and perpetual artificial rain. Corporate loyalty, privacy paranoia, suspicion as reflex. Advanced forensics (biometric, neural, digital), security chiefs as de facto police, airtight proof required. PR spin dominates, leaks spark scandal, whistleblowers vanish. Cynical tone with themes of trust and betrayal.

characters.name: Dr. Sarah Chen
characters.backstory: AI ethics scientist, loyal to science and her late mentor Park, torn by betrayal.
characters.motivations: Driven by loyalty to science and uncovering truth, haunted by past betrayals.

characters.name: Dr. James Park
characters.backstory: Visionary AI scientist, idealistic and trusting, now deceased.
characters.motivations: Pushed AI-CORE project forward, protective of his research.

chapters.chapter_summary: Dr. Sarah Chen notices an anomaly late at night in Hyperion Labs: Dr. James Park’s office light is still on past midnight. She overhears a tense argument between Park and Elena Volkov. The city’s neon-lit rain-soaked atmosphere mirrors the tension. Sarah’s unease grows as trust feels fragile and broken.

scenes.scene_description: Establishing the neon-lit, rain-soaked cityscape of Pacifica Arcology, setting the mood and atmosphere.

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in rain-drenched neon noir style. Establishing shot of Pacifica Arcology at night, towering glass skyscrapers with neon veins of blue and violet light tracing down their sleek surfaces. Artificial rain cascades, reflecting the neon glow in puddles and mist. The city is a vertical labyrinth of steel and light, shrouded in mist. Cool, saturated colors dominate with sharp contrasts. Portrait 4:5.

A single comic book panel in rain-drenched neon noir style. Wide shot looking down a rain-speckled street canyon between towering glass spires. Neon signs flicker and reflect in wet surfaces. Mist swirls around street-level, obscuring figures in the distance. The rain blurs the sharp edges of the city, creating a dreamlike, tense atmosphere. Portrait 4:5.
panels.primary_action: Rain and neon in city street

pages.page_description: Establishing the neon-lit rain-soaked cityscape of Pacifica Arcology.

scenes.scene_description: Dr. Sarah Chen works late surrounded by holographic neural maps and data streams. She notices Park’s office light still on, unusual for him. The sterile lab atmosphere contrasts with the neon city outside.

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in rain-drenched neon noir style. Medium shot of Dr. Sarah Chen seated at a sleek workstation surrounded by floating holographic neural maps and data streams. Her fingers flick through the air, manipulating glowing blue and violet data. The sterile lab glows with cold white and blue light. Outside the rain-speckled window, neon reflections flicker. Portrait 4:5.

A single comic book panel in rain-drenched neon noir style. Close-up of Sarah’s face, eyes sharp and alert, reflecting the holographic data. Her brow furrows as she notices an anomaly. The cold lab light casts subtle shadows on her features. Portrait 4:5.

A single comic book panel in rain-drenched neon noir style. Wide shot showing Sarah’s perspective through the rain-speckled window. Outside, the city’s neon blue and violet streaks flicker across steel-gray clouds. The lab’s sterile interior contrasts with the vibrant, chaotic cityscape. Portrait 4:5.
panels.primary_action: Sarah looks out window at neon city

dialogue.text: Park’s office light still burned past midnight — unusual for the cautious scientist.

pages.page_description: Sarah works late, notices Park’s office light still on, and contemplates the neon city outside.

scenes.location: Hyperion Labs - Corridor Outside Park’s Office
scenes.scene_description: Sarah walks down the corridor, muffled voices of Park and Elena arguing reach her. She pauses, heart pounding, listening to the tense confrontation.

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in rain-drenched neon noir style. Medium shot of Dr. Sarah Chen walking cautiously down a dimly lit corridor lined with sleek metal and glass. Her breath fogs the air near a rain-speckled window. The corridor is bathed in cold blue light from overhead panels. Portrait 4:5.

A single comic book panel in rain-drenched neon noir style. Close-up of Sarah’s ear pressed against the doorframe, eyes wide with concern. The door’s frosted glass glows faintly with light from inside. Portrait 4:5.
panels.sound_effects: Tense voices, clipped Russian and calm baritone

panels.location: Hyperion Labs - Inside Park’s Office (through frosted glass)
panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in rain-drenched neon noir style. Over-the-shoulder shot from behind Sarah, showing blurred silhouettes of Dr. James Park and Elena Volkov arguing inside the office. Park’s calm baritone contrasts with Elena’s clipped Russian tone. The room glows with holographic displays. Portrait 4:5.
panels.primary_action: Argument between Park and Elena overheard

pages.page_description: Sarah overhears a tense argument between Park and Elena through the office door.

scenes.scene_description: The argument fades. Sarah clutches her neural notepad, haunted by memories of betrayal. The city outside holds its breath beneath the neon glow. She steels herself to continue work, but the night feels different.

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in rain-drenched neon noir style. Close-up of Sarah’s hands clutching a worn neural notepad, thumb tracing its edges. The holographic glow softly illuminates her tense fingers. Portrait 4:5.

A single comic book panel in rain-drenched neon noir style. Medium shot of Sarah turning away from the window, her face shadowed but determined. The neon city outside glows faintly through the rain-speckled glass. Portrait 4:5.
panels.primary_action: Sarah steels herself to continue work

dialogue.text: The city held its breath beneath the neon glow. Tonight, trust felt broken.

pages.page_description: Sarah reflects on betrayal and prepares to continue her work as the city waits.
